ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail full sync committee handling or light client update mechanisms, focusing only on execution payload changes
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume sync committee and update mechanisms are inherited unchanged from Capella light client sync protocol. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The boundary condition when epoch == DENEB_FORK_EPOCH for the first block is not explicitly addressed for execution root computation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that at exactly DENEB_FORK_EPOCH, the Deneb computation path (hash_tree_root of full Deneb header) is used. This is based on the >= comparison in the spec.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Capella-compatible header construction correctly excludes only blob gas fields and preserves all other fields in the correct order
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect field stripping could produce wrong execution roots, causing valid headers to fail verification or invalid headers to pass.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot craft a header where blob_gas_used or excess_blob_gas are non-zero for pre-Deneb epochs that still passes Merkle verification
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could allow injection of fake blob gas values into pre-Deneb light client state, potentially confusing fee market calculations.
